review_method: all 90 normalized input/output pairs viewed in six packet contact sheets; separate six-face old/new M9 band review
limits: no pixel-exact glyph or plane polygons; visual absence of obvious clipping is not segmentation accuracy
X and the top boundary are inherited, not newly localized; only lower vertical side-wall trimming is tested
two original matches; correlated frames and faces do not add independent matches
old 75 inputs remain reviewed manual face crops, not automatic group-splitter outputs
eight abstentions are retained without fixed-ratio fallback
private/public all-class controls outside these 90 faces are not evaluated here
no identity scoring, confidence fitting, Runtime integration, or blind validation
